result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a broken-looking empty avatar button in the top-right and layout clipping at the right edge and above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Top-right circular button appears as an empty light-grey circle with only a small red dot and no avatar, icon or image inside, looking broken or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Load the user avatar or display a default profile/bell icon; ensure placeholder state is never a blank circle.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card in Popular right now (-20% pizza) is abruptly clipped by the bottom tab bar with no padding, making content appear cut off behind navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset above the tab bar so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Rightmost category filter chip is sliced at the screen edge with no end padding or scroll affordance, looking cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and a fade or scroll indicator to make the horizontal scrollable row intentional.
